item.title: Fewer sales, more choice: who benefits from this changing market?
item.description: Property Whispers, November 16, 2026: October figures show slower transactions in Greater Montreal, but no broad collapse in selling prices. Market numbers, a Laval lens, readers' questions and home tips.
